column1: # The libraries 3Drop links, as the pinned build image holds them (tools/lint.Dockerfile), and where
# their exact sources and devkitPro's build recipes come from. tools/librarySources.sh reads this file
# at every release: it stops unless `dkp-pacman -Q` in the image gives each `library` row's version,
# and unless every `file` row downloads to its SHA-256.
# Tab-separated, one row a line; a line that starts with # is a comment.
#   library  <package>  <version, as dkp-pacman -Q prints it>  <license>  <upstream>  <devkitPro's recipe at that version's commit>
# To bump a library (after changing the image, or when a release stops with "the build image has"):
#   1. docker run --rm "$(sed -n 's/^FROM //p' tools/lint.Dockerfile)" dkp-pacman -Q gives the version.
#   2. In github.com/devkitPro/pacman-packages, find the commit that made that version of the
#      package's folder (its history names it). That is the recipe's commit: change it in the
#      library row and in every recipe URL below.
#   3. The recipe's PKGBUILD lists the source's URL and SHA-256; a new patch file is a new recipe row.
#   4. sha256sum each file you now name, and put it on its row.
#   5. bash tools/librarySources.sh <folder> must then pass: it checks every row against the image
# A URL that dies is replaced here, never the hash: the hash is what makes the bytes the exact ones.
# A downloaded source is stored as it came; a recipe is the PKGBUILD and the patches it applies.
# newlib, libgcc and the other toolchain pieces are devkitARM's, not listed here.
